posts.zh:
dsh-compressor 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9480ba46d4cbcdf43b80.html
posts.en:
dsh-compressor is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9480ba46d4cbcdf43b80.html
